Definition: Arad, the name of a place near Palestine, also of a Canaanite and an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Arad is the name of a Canaanite king and his city in the south, a Benjamite, and a place. King Arad fought Israel and took some prisoners, Joshua lists the king of Arad among the thirty-one kings he struck down, the Kenites settled in the wilderness south of Arad, and a son of Beriah in Benjamin is also named Arad.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Arad shows that a city can fight Israel, fall to Israel, and still give its name to the land, because God writes the whole map, not only the victories.
